said: In two years the Democrats were responsible for record inflation.
record: FactCheck.org checked the Jan. 3, 2023 nominating speech. Inflation was high. It was not a record. The Consumer Price Index peak in this period was below the 1980 peak.
The Energy Information Administration reports the United States has produced more energy than it consumed every year since 2019, including under Biden. FactCheck.org, Jan. 3, 2023.

said: As we stood on this House floor, over 200 people were poisoned from fentanyl that came from an open border.
record: FactCheck.org, Jan. 4, 2023. About 107,000 people died of drug overdoses in 2021, not 200 a day from fentanyl at the border that afternoon. Most fentanyl is seized at legal ports of entry.
